title: WWDC 2026: Apple makes its big Siri AI reveal, changes Liquid Glass and more
raw_text:
Apple used its Worldwide Developers Conference on Monday in Cupertino, Calif., to roll out a plethora of new features and updates, including the long-awaited overhaul of Siri AI.
The software updates revealed on Monday at WWDC will launch alongside new hardware in the fall.
Apple also unveiled more of its artificial intelligence strategy, including its partnership to use Google's Gemini models.
Apple stock has neared record highs in recent weeks as investors and analysts approved of a Google AI partnership announced in January and the latest iPhones have shown strong, continuing sales momentum.
It's the last annual developer conference for Tim Cook as CEO of Apple, and he had a farewell message at the end of the keynote video.
John Ternus, who will replace Cook as CEO in September, was not featured during the keynote presentation.
What you need to know:
- Tim Cook's farewell message
- Apple shares slide during WWDC
- Apple adds features to child safety tools for parents
- Siri gets upgrades and a new name: Siri AI
- Apple Intelligence and personal data
- Liquid Glass changes
- Next MacOS named "Golden Gate"
CNBC reporters are on the ground in Cupertino, California, and will track what the iPhone maker says about Apple Intelligence, Siri, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS and tvOS, plus any impact on developers, consumers and investors.
